Messages.Author: Matthew T. Morgan
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 8 Mar 2005 adam....@ngc.com wrote:

> Hmmm... LSJ! You tricked me. I wasted a lot of time on that deck!

Change all those Banishments for KRCs and you still may have a good deck.
You pay 1 pool for a minion who can remove titles! You get the added
bonus of being immune to stuff like Form of Corruption, Temptation of
Greater Power, Graverobbing and other annoying effects. You can block
vampires who Dare the Dawn.

It's just a matter of changing your plan from "I'll gain 4 pool per turn"
to "I'll do 3 pool to my prey per turn." It's not a bad strategy.

Matt Morgan

Messages.Author: Matthew T. Morgan
Messages.Body:
On Tue, 8 Mar 2005, Daneel wrote:

> You could probably recycle her with things like Social Ladder, or the Soul
> Gem. Hmm. There must be an über-combo for Soul Gem... Turbo Sonja, anyone?

Social Ladder is a pretty good idea, although it's kind of a slow way to
bring out your fatties.

Turbo-Sonja (in the style of Turbo-Arika) would be pretty difficult.
You'd only want to Diamond Thunderbolt once, in theory, because you're
hoping to sweep the table during your next minion phase. Also, if you
Soul Gem up a new Sonja, you won't get the 4 pool because you only get
that when you move her to your ready region during your influence phase.
If only there were a way to rescue vampires from torpor during your
influence phase.

It's possible that removing Sonja from the game might interact strangely
with the Soul Gem, but it seems to me like it would work normally. I
can't see why it wouldn't.

Matt Morgan
